svg.text: 1 — CONVERSION (reader chosen from the file itself, never from its suffix; one mzML cache per study)
2 — IDENTIFICATION (per injection: every MS2 spectrum against the target AND the decoy libraries)
3 — FEATURE DETECTION (+ per-file mass calibration as a second pass)
4 — PEAK FINDER (join identifications to features, then the reproduced filters)
7 — CROSS-POLARITY, REPORT AND FEEDBACK TO THE INSTRUMENT (needs both polarities)
the two blocks on their own scales
